sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Check current state
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
print("Nodes:")
for n in nodes:
    if n['color'] != 'S':
        print(f"  {n['color']} id={n['id']}: pixels={n['pixels']}, boundary={n['boundary'][:4]}")

# Try clicking on the white F to reposition it
# White F is at bottom, let's find its center
w_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'W' and n['pixels'] > 10]
if w_nodes:
    w = w_nodes[0]
    # Get center of white F
    rows = [p[0] for p in w['boundary']]
    cols = [p[1] for p in w['boundary']]
    center_row = sum(rows) // len(rows)
    center_col = sum(cols) // len(cols)
    print(f"White F center: ({center_row}, {center_col})")
    
    # Try clicking on white F
    result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center_row, 'col': center_col}])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    nodes = seg['nodes']
    w_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'W' and n['pixels'] > 10]
    char_pos = w_nodes[0]['boundary'][0] if w_nodes else None
    print(f"After MOUSE on white F: char at {char_pos}, level_completed={result.get('level_completed')}")
    
    # Check if character moved out of HUD
    if char_pos and char_pos[0] < 10:
        print("Still in HUD, try LEFT/RIGHT")
        # Try LEFT
        result = action(['LEFT'])
        seg = current_frame.segmentation
        nodes = seg['nodes']
        w_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'W' and n['pixels'] > 10]
        char_pos = w_nodes[0]['boundary'][0] if w_nodes else None
        print(f"After LEFT: char at {char_pos}")
        
        # Try RIGHT
        result = action(['RIGHT'])
        seg = current_frame.segmentation
        nodes = seg['nodes']
        w_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'W' and n['pixels'] > 10]
        char_pos = w_nodes[0]['boundary'][0] if w_nodes else None
        print(f"After RIGHT: char at {char_pos}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
